title: Desk Rule — Which Charges on a Building Automation Service Plan Are Required at a Settlement
content:
# Desk Rule — Which Charges on a Building Automation Service Plan Are Required at a Settlement

**The rule.** Where the twelve months to the handling day carry three or more charges that fell due on a plan under the Building Automation Service Plans and no payment has been received in the last four months, every charge standing unsettled on the plan is required now, whether or not it has yet fallen due. Where the twelve months to the handling day carry three or more charges that fell due on the plan and a payment has been received in the last four months, the charges standing unsettled other than those that fell due inside the last month are required now. In every other case only the charges that have already fallen due within the twelve months to the handling day, less what has been paid and credited, are required now.

| Charges that fell due in the twelve months to the handling day | Payments received in the last 4 months | What is required now |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | none | every charge standing unsettled on the plan, fallen due or not |
| 3 or more | at least 1 | the charges standing unsettled other than those that fell due inside the last month |
| fewer than 3 | any | only the charges already fallen due within the twelve months, less what has been paid and credited |

## Points of judgement

- The count in the first column is of charges that fell due in the window, not of charges raised in it; a charge raised inside the window whose due day falls after it is not counted.
- Exactly 3 charges fallen due in the twelve months meets the first column, the boundary being three or more. A payment received exactly 4 months before the handling day falls inside the last four months.
- In the first two rows the whole unsettled position is in view, so charges that have not yet fallen due can be required; in the third row only charges already fallen due within the twelve months are.

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A plan shows 4 charges fallen due in the twelve months to the handling day, 6200 USD standing unsettled in all, of which 900 USD fell due inside the last month, and one payment received two months ago. The second row applies, so the charges required now are 6200 USD less 900 USD, that is 5300.00 USD. Had no payment been received in the last four months, the first row would apply and the whole 6200.00 USD would be required now.
